basic_info.description:
High floor in a brand new, remodeled building in the heart of the Richmond, off Clement street (close to California & Lake streets). Large open kitchen, dining and living room space. Moroccan / Venetian Plaster walls for vibey, cozy, warm feel. Main 2 rooms have their own en- suite bathrooms. Large private outdoor deck. All brand new amenities. KitchenAid oven/stove. Radiant floor heating. This is a special place. Come check it out. Min 6 month but 1year+ preferred

Owner pays for wifi. Renter is responsible for electricity and water. 1 year lease strongly preferred, will consider other situations. 1st month and 1 month security deposit due at signing.
